column1: # Committed ecbench sessions with a known, owner-dispositioned integrity defect.
# Committed evidence is never edited, so a defective session stays in the tree
# and is audited on every run: .github/scripts/ecbench-audit-sessions.sh hashes
# all five capsule files against these pins and runs `ecbench verify` on it.
# The row passes only if verify fails with exactly the pinned problem checks;
# a changed byte, a new problem or a vanished one fails CI. Such a session is
# never integrity-passed and must not be cited beyond its defect note.
# Defect notes and owner approvals: docs/ecbench/DEFECTIVE_SESSIONS.md.
